<p>SINS OF THE FATHER! ENTER GRENDEL —  a super villain from Jeff Morales' past who will stop at nothing to have his revenge against the former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent... but their seemingly perfect plan didn't count on SPIDER-MAN!
